Triage agent

Triage agent not available

The triage agent sandbox is not installed on the MMHotline server. Run sudo mmhotline install on the team's Linux server.

Playbook rules decide which fixes need a person.

Where the triage agent is set up

Set in /etc/mmhotline/mmhotline_settings.yml, in triage_agent and review_agent. An administrator edits the settings file with sudoedit, then runs sudo mmhotline settings apply.

Times are New York time (America/New_York), the team's time zone.
